title.note: Game title kept byte-identical (glossary: keep, brand).

hud.cast.blind_remark: on its own 'Lancer' can also read as 'Launch' or 'Start'

hud.reel.note: 'Mouliner' is the fishing verb for turning the reel (moulinet) to bring the line in; matches the pass name 'Moulinet auto'. Exactly 8. Plainer fallback: 'Remonter'.

hud.bait_left.note: Label-colon form: count can be 0 or 1, and '1 appâts' would be wrong.

catch.success.note: {rarity} follows the fixed masculine noun 'poisson', so every tier agrees whatever the fish's gender (Carpe and Anguille are feminine); no article before {fish}. The tier shows capitalized mid-sentence, as a tier name.

catch.escaped.note: 'It' made explicit with the generic 'poisson', as the context allows; single ellipsis character per the fr-ca guide.

catch.new_record.note: For the developer: {weight} arrives as '12.4'; fr-ca writes '12,4 kg' (decimal comma), so the game should format it for fr-ca.

fish.lantern_eel.note: Modeled on the real French 'poisson-lanterne' (lanternfish); keeps the glowing-lantern idea. 17 of 18.

shop.rods.note: 'Cannes à pêche' is 14, over the 10 budget; in a fishing shop tab 'Cannes' reads as fishing rods.
shop.rods.blind_remark: bare 'Cannes' without 'a peche' can also read as canes or walking sticks, or the city of Cannes

shop.equipped.note: State label; feminine to agree with 'canne' (the rod it sits on), as the context asks.

shop.free.note: Invariable price-tag form, as French stores show it.

shop.buy_robux.note: Fr-ca guide's pattern for pass buttons; 'Acheter pour {price} Robux' also fits (19) but runs long with 4-digit prices.

pass.auto_reel.note: 'Automatic reel', built on the same root as hud.reel 'Mouliner'. 13 of 14. The Creator Hub pass name should match.

pass.lucky_bait.text: Appât de chance double tes chances de pêcher des poissons rares!
pass.lucky_bait.note: 'Appât de chance' follows the guide's 'Potion de chance' pattern (luck = chance, Bait = appât).
pass.lucky_bait.blind_remark: name reads literally 'bait of luck', a little stiff; 'chance' then 'chances' repeats

sell.done.note: Label-colon form because count and coins can each be 1 ('1 poissons', '1 pièces' would be wrong). For the developer: coins of 1000+ need a no-break-space thousands separator for fr-ca ('1 250').

sell.prompt.note: 'Appuie sur E pour vendre' is 24, over 21; 'Touche E pour...' is the fr-ca guide's short prompt form. E kept.
sell.prompt.blind_remark: ambiguous: 'Touche' reads as either the noun 'key' or the verb 'touch', so also 'Touch E to sell'

ascend.button.note: Noun button, as French UI allows; the usual French name for this prestige mechanic. In a fishing game it reads as rising up, not religious.

ascend.confirm.text: Faire l'ascension maintenant? Tu recommenceras à zéro, mais tu pêcheras des poissons rares {bonus} % plus souvent.
ascend.confirm.note: Same 'ascension' as the button. 'Faire l'ascension' can also mean climbing a mountain, but right after pressing Ascension it reads as the mechanic. No-break space before %.

weather.storm.text: Une tempête approche! Les poissons rares mordent.
weather.storm.note: 'Mordre' is the fishing sense of 'bite'. Second sentence ends with a period: the fr-ca guide allows at most one '!' per string.

quest.catch_n.note: Label-colon form: n can be 1 ('Pêche 1 poissons' would be wrong). Exactly 40. The fuller 'Poissons à pêcher à la baie Clair-de-Lune : {n}' is 44 if the line has room. Generic 'baie' lowercase in running text, Quebec toponymy style.

friends.boost.text: Pêcher avec tes amis donne +{percent} % de chance
friends.boost.note: No-break space before %, as fr-ca writes it.
friends.boost.blind_remark: 'chance' can mean luck or odds; does not say odds of what

trade.accept.note: 'avoir' past tense, so nothing agrees with the player's unknown gender; 'your trade' made explicit as the request, per context. 31 of 33.

codes.redeemed.text: Code activé! Profite de ta récompense.

afk.kicked.text: Tu as été AFK trop longtemps, alors ta pêche s'est arrêtée.
afk.kicked.note: AFK per the fr-ca guide: 'Tu es resté inactif' would need a gendered participle. 'ta pêche s'est arrêtée' = your fishing stopped, per context; no kick mentioned.

event.ends.note: For the developer: {time} arrives as '2d 4h'; fr-ca needs '2 j 4 h' (no-break spaces), so the game should format it for fr-ca.

daily.streak.text: Jour {day} de ta série! Reviens demain pour d'autres récompenses.
daily.streak.note: 'Jour {day}' needs no plural, so day = 1 is safe. 'for more' made explicit as more rewards, per context.

tip.night.text: Astuce : certains poissons ne mordent que la nuit.

group.join.text: Rejoins notre communauté pour 50 appâts gratuits!
group.join.note: Roblox calls player groups 'communautés' in French (fr-ca guide); 'notre' as in the guide's reference line.

leaderboard.biggest.note: Fishing idiom for the heaviest fish caught; 'La plus grosse prise' is 20, over 18.
